name: San Francisco Bay

climate: Chardonnay, Cabernet Sauvignon, Zinfandel and Merlot sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

blurb.text: A multi-county Central Coast AVA around the San Francisco Bay Area, covering the South and East Bay counties. Chardonnay and Cabernet Sauvignon lead plantings, and it contains Livermore Valley and Santa Clara Valley.
